opportunities.name: United flight search (origin, destination, dates, passengers, cabin)
opportunities.description: Fill the United.com Book flight form with origin, destination, depart/return dates, passengers and cabin class, then click Find flights and open a fare.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight
Choose roundtrip or one-way
Type origin city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Type destination city and pick the matching suggestion
Open the Dates picker and click the depart and return dates, paging months as needed
Set travelers (adults/children) and cabin class
Click Find flights
Optionally select a fare or open Details/Seats

instances.values: one-way, book with miles, SMF to IAH, Jun 2
BWI to NYC, Aug 2 to Aug 7, 1 adult
PNQ to NYC, Jun 9 to Jun 11, selected fare $2,984
BOM to LON, Jul 1 to Jul 5, 2 adults + 1 child, premium economy
SPI to AUS, one-way, date changed to Apr 29, opened Details/Seats
SAF to PHX, Aug 13 to Aug 28, selected $681 fare

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search by city with filters
opportunities.description: On Tripadvisor, open Restaurants, search a location, then apply filters (cuisine, features) to the results.
steps: Click Restaurants on the Tripadvisor home page
Type the location in the Where to? search box
Select the matching location suggestion
Open Show more in the filter sidebar if needed
Tick the desired filter checkbox (cuisine, dietary, feature)
Click Apply if a modal appears

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search a venue, choose an event, optionally filter (wheelchair accessible), set start time or sort, and update the search.
steps: Type venue name in Search for parking
Pick the venue suggestion
Pick an event from the events modal, or select an event date first
Adjust enter-after/exit-before times and click Update Search if needed
Open Filter, tick an amenity such as Wheelchair Accessible, click Show results
Change sort order (distance or price)
Click Book Now on a garage if required

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic event, 3 PM to 5 PM, sort by distance, Book Now
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals, wheelchair accessible, sort by price
Barclays Center, date Apr 9, 76ers event, wheelchair accessible, start 10 AM

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor Reco trip designer request
opportunities.description: Start a Reco trip designer request for a destination, answering the wizard for dates, occasion, travelers, budget, activities and vibe.
steps: Open More > Hire a Trip Designer
Type destination and select it
Click Get Started
Pick travel dates in the calendar and click Next
Select occasion and click Next
Set adults, children and child ages and click Next
Choose budget from and to values and click Next
Select activities and click Next
Select vibe and click Next

instances.values: Egypt, Jul 1 to Jul 4, family vacation, 2 adults + 1 child aged 8, $4,000-$6,000, attractions/cuisine/history/shopping, adventurous

opportunities.name: United map-search flexible dates
opportunities.description: Use United's Map search with flexible dates from an origin airport.
steps: Click Book > Map search
Type origin and select the airport
Set Roundtrip
Open Flexible dates and select the Flexible Dates tab
Click Search

instances.values: Las Vegas LAS, roundtrip, flexible dates
